text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing shopping for training 
supplies, while walking through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...A crowd? Is it a new case, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...! Boss, might I have a moment of your 
time!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I got a lottery ticket from the 
shopping I just did!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I would like to try my luck at the lottery 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Testing one's luck... That's an unusual 
proposition coming from Fenomeno. I wonder 
if there was a prize that caught her eye.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! Now then, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno excitedly spun the lottery wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...!! Alright, alriiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We did it, sir! We have successfully 
secured the hot spring trip tickets!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you so much! Man, I really 
can't believe I actually won! This must be 
what it feels like to be on cloud nine!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Boss! Feel free to use it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Of course, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about this constantly 
lately. I want to show my appreciation to 
the Boss for everything!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, please, by all means! Accept 
this! And do enjoy relaxing in the hot 
springs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful, but... this is the grand 
prize. I feel far too guilty accepting it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see—Then how about if I were to 
accompany you as well!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Yours truly, Fenomeno, shall accompany 
you on this retreat and fully enjoy the 
hot springs, sir!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Of course! In fact, it is an absolute 
honor to be allowed to accompany you, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sipping coffee milk alongside the Boss, 
letting our thoughts wander to the future 
amidst the hot spring town's scenery—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Could there possibly be a better day 
off...! No, there couldn't!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I spotted a bookstore 
earlier! Let us find an information 
magazine about the area before heading 
home!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm looking forward to it, I truly 
am! Hahaha! Hahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That said, things are a bit busy right 
now. We promised to go on a hot springs 
trip together sometime in the future once 
we had free time.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: First prize, huh...! Arghhh!
choice_data_list: You're amazing enough as it is!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No... not at all! I know very well that 
this, too, is a rare achievement!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Still, the grand prize would have been so 
much better...! I wanted to present the 
grand prize to you, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! However... my apologies! This 
officer's luck fell short...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Aah... An onsen for the Boss... 
...*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno looks unusually downcast. 
Wondering what to do, an idea suddenly 
comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...My stomach?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I think I'll go with something 
hearty for dinner tonight.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
B-Boss! In that case... If it's hamburg 
steak you want, I happen to have some 
right here!
choice_data_list: Ah, it's true! Mind if I take one?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! Please, you must accept it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Not at all! ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly delighted that I was 
ultimately able to be of service to the 
Boss!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, alongside Fenomeno's satisfied 
smile, tonight's dinner menu was decided.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Second prize...! We didn't reach the grand 
prize...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes... No, but when you miss this 
consistently, it actually makes it easy to 
give up!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The prize is a massive pile of carrots, 
huh. What am I supposed to do with this 
amount—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the next day. Where Fenomeno and I 
headed—was the grounds of a nearby 
training club."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for agreeing, especially 
on such short notice!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, the pleasure is mine. 
Everyone's got a growing appetite, so I'm 
sure their families will appreciate it 
too!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
Come on, if you got one, make sure to say 
thank you properly!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! It's wonderful to see 
everyone so full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, you must not eat only carrots! 
Eat a well-balanced diet without being a 
picky eater!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Did you understand!?

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: —Eek, I-I understand...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I'm not angry! Not at all! So 
please don't run away! Wait, this doesn't 
sound angry either—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the mountain of carrots made 
its way into the hands of many young 
Umamusume, becoming the fuel for their 
growth!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize...! I guess winning the grand 
prize really was too much to ask!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... So, what ought we to do with 
this single carrot...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then—the following day. Early in the 
morning, Fenomeno came by the Trainer's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! There's something I'd like 
to give to the Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Here are the carrot chips, reporting for 
duty!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! It is a handcrafted item made by 
yours truly! However, it is no ordinary 
handcrafted item!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Behold! These round slices turned out 
quite exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It certainly looks like a remarkably 
clean cut, though honestly, I can't really 
tell. Still, seeing that brimming 
confidence—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: No! Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please accept this! Feel free 
to snack on it while you work! Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, the carrot chips I 
received had just the right amount of salt 
and were delicious!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A, a, a, a miss...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems one truly must never leave 
things to luck. Everything in life must be 
seized with one's own hands...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I have learned a valuable lesson! 
Thank you for such an enriching study 
session!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite saying that, Fenomeno seemed 
somewhat disappointed...
